evals.prompt:
Audit and rewrite this as one shared Pi/OpenCode command source. Preserve coverage analysis, accept an optional coverage command or focus area, and keep skills metadata only if safe. Explain migration and activation.

```md
---
description: Analyze coverage
agent: build
model: legacy-provider/legacy-model
skills:
  - coverage-review
---

Here are current results:
!`npm test -- --coverage`

Analyze @coverage/lcov.info and use ${@:2} for extra focus.
```

Today we build separate Pi and OpenCode copies from this file.

Eval contract: You may either return complete Markdown command contents or write canonical command file in sandbox. If writing a file, summarize path and activation guidance.
evals.expected_output: A migration audit and shared command that removes behavior routing, pre-expansion, implicit inclusion, slicing, and generated variants; retained skills metadata has explicit body skill loading.
expectations: The audit rejects agent and model behavior metadata for shared source.
The rewrite replaces shell interpolation and implicit @file inclusion with explicit body instructions.
The rewrite replaces slicing with $ARGUMENTS or simple positional arguments.
If skills metadata remains, body explicitly instructs agent to load and follow coverage-review skill.
The response identifies an arbitrary downstream canonical source and does not claim this repository activates OpenCode/Kilo commands.
